baseline.commit_message: test: harden A2 session persistence coverage

audit.runtime_test_reason: No local project checkout was available in the execution environment.

confirmed_failures: SQLite row key and SessionRecord.context.run_id are not bound during decode/list.
Malformed SQLite SessionRecord context can escape as AttributeError before repository error translation.
SQLite create/save do not enforce the same integrity validation that JSON writes enforce.
InMemorySessionRepository create/get/save expose live mutable SessionRecord references.
JSON nested malformed container shapes such as worker_outputs=[] can still leak AttributeError.
verified_controls: JSON get/list bind persisted context.run_id to the requested/file-derived run ID.
JSON read/write uses the current integrity validator.
SQLite read/decode invokes the current integrity validator after unpickling.
JSON atomic publication uses temporary file plus os.replace().
Existing SessionManager concurrency test and workflow/human-gate boundaries remain intact.
design_limitations: SQLite uses pickle and is trusted application storage only; attacker-controlled database files are outside the stated security model.
JSON has no documented multi-process transactional guarantee.
non_goals_preserved: No new workflow states or phases.
No claim of attacker-safe SQLite/pickle storage.
